desc: Count character frequencies in `s` (array of size 26).
For each candidate target frequency `k` from 1 to `n`, compute the minimum cost using the formula `excess + max(unkept, deficit)` while greedily keeping the top `d` counts (incrementally).
Optimize the inner loop to O(1) per `d` by updating running totals of `excess`, `deficit`, and `unkept` incrementally.
Return the global minimum cost across all `k` and `d`.
Implement `Solution.makeStringGood` with the final optimized code.
